sources.title: Illustrious - Learn AI
sources.snippet: Within three months of its initial release, the model's influence became so pervasive that civitai, the largest repository for AI art models and resources, created a dedicated "Illustrious Checkpoint" category to organize the flood of derivative models, LoRA adapters, and related resources built upon the Illustrious base.
